items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: I had an old fellow player to me, but it wasn't much time, but I sang God he was a bass player named Joe Cable.

ctx.x: Tell me, Jean Tom. I haven't seen him in a long time. No, I haven't seen him since I've been here. Well, I had an old fellow player to me, but it wasn't much time, but I sang God he was a bass player named Joe Cable. He's pretty alright.
I didn't think he was a pretend fellow.
